business.what_it_does: Company provides life insurance, pension, savings, health and group insurance products to individuals and institutions in India.

segments.name: Unit Linked
segments.what: Unit-linked life and pension insurance products for individuals and groups.

segments.name: Participating
segments.what: Participating life, pension and variable insurance products for individuals.

segments.name: Non Participating
segments.what: Non-participating life, annuity, pension, health and variable insurance products.

business.mix_note: Operates across 35 locations in India, serving mass market, middle-class, affluent, and institutional customers.

credibility.line: Management consistently meets its guidance ranges for growth and VNB margins, supported by reported operational metrics.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed 17% PAT growth for H1 FY27 to INR12.7 billion, supported by reported Q2 FY27 PAT of INR549 crore and Q1 FY27 PAT of INR725 crore.
Annual PAT grew from INR2413 crore in FY25 to INR2470 crore in FY26, aligning with reported profit growth claims.
Equity increased steadily from INR16985 crore in March 2025 to INR19086 crore in March 2026 and INR20539 crore by Sep 2026.

bull: PAT grew 17% year-on-year to INR12.7 billion for H1 FY27.
Equity base expanded to INR20539 crore as of Sep 2026 from INR16985 crore in March 2025.
Company remains practically debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of -0.0.
bear: Quarterly revenue shows extreme volatility, dropping 82.4% YoY in Mar 2026.
EBITDA margins remain depressed below 3%, hitting negative figures in Mar 2025 and Mar 2026.
Operating cash flow conversion and financial volatility do not match the steady insurance metric claims.
